record.original_question: For a finite abelian group G, determine the minimum size of a subset A needed so that A spans G under each of the standard sumset operations: hA = G, [0,s]A = G, ⟨A⟩ = G, h±A = G, [0,s]±A = G, restricted ĥA = G, restricted [0,s]Â = G, ΣA = G, restricted signed ĥ±A = G, restricted signed [0,s]̂±A = G, and Σ±A = G. Equivalently, determine the spanning-set threshold functions φ, φ±, φ̂, and φ̂± and characterize extremal spanning sets where possible.

artifact.category_tag: spanning sets in finite abelian groups
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite abelian group (written additively) and let $A \subseteq G$ be a nonempty subset. For a positive integer $h$, define the following sumsets:

(Unrestricted) $hA = \{a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_h : a_i \in A\}$, $[0,s]A = \bigcup_{h=0}^{s} hA$ (with $0A = \{0\}$), and $\langle A\rangle = \bigcup_{h\ge 0} hA$, the subgroup generated by $A$.

(Unrestricted, signed) $h_\pm A = \{\varepsilon_1 a_1 + \cdots + \varepsilon_h a_h : a_i \in A,\; \varepsilon_i \in \{+1,-1\}\}$ and $[0,s]_\pm A = \bigcup_{h=0}^{s} h_\pm A$.

(Restricted) $\hat h A = \{a_{i_1} + \cdots + a_{i_h} : 1 \le i_1 < \cdots < i_h \le |A|,\; a_{i_j}\in A\}$ (sums of $h$ distinct elements of $A$), $[0,s]\hat{\,} A = \bigcup_{h=0}^{s} \hat h A$, and $\Sigma A = \bigcup_{h=0}^{|A|} \hat h A$, the set of all subset sums of $A$.

(Restricted, signed) $\hat h_\pm A = \{\varepsilon_1 a_{i_1} + \cdots + \varepsilon_h a_{i_h} : 1\le i_1<\cdots<i_h\le |A|,\; \varepsilon_j\in\{+1,-1\}\}$, $[0,s]\hat{\,}_\pm A$ analogously, and $\Sigma_\pm A = \bigcup_{h=0}^{|A|} \hat h_\pm A$.

Define the spanning-set threshold functions
\[
\begin{aligned}
\varphi(G,h) &= \min\{|A| : A\subseteq G,\ hA = G\}, & \varphi(G,[0,s]) &= \min\{|A| : [0,s]A=G\},\\
\varphi(G,\mathbb N_0) &= \min\{|A| : \langle A\rangle = G\},\\
\varphi_\pm(G,h) &= \min\{|A| : h_\pm A = G\}, & \varphi_\pm(G,[0,s]) &= \min\{|A| : [0,s]_\pm A=G\},\\
\hat\varphi(G,h) &= \min\{|A| : \hat h A = G\}, & \hat\varphi(G,[0,s]) &= \min\{|A| : [0,s]\hat{\,} A=G\},\\
\hat\varphi(G,\mathbb N_0) &= \min\{|A| : \Sigma A = G\},\\
\hat\varphi_\pm(G,h) &= \min\{|A| : \hat h_\pm A = G\}, & \hat\varphi_\pm(G,[0,s]) &= \min\{|A| : [0,s]\hat{\,}_\pm A=G\},\\
\hat\varphi_\pm(G,\mathbb N_0) &= \min\{|A| : \Sigma_\pm A = G\}.
\end{aligned}
\]

Determine, for every finite abelian group $G$ and all relevant parameters $h, s$, the exact values of each of these threshold functions, and characterize the extremal subsets $A\subseteq G$ that attain them.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is presented as a broad family of open questions on spanning thresholds for finite abelian groups under various sumset operations. Partial results exist for special groups (cyclic groups, elementary abelian groups) and special parameter regimes, but a complete determination of $\varphi, \varphi_\pm, \hat\varphi, \hat\varphi_\pm$ for all finite abelian groups remains open.

status_evidence.title: Additive Combinatorics: A Menu of Research Problems
status_evidence.snippet: A book-length compendium of open questions in additive combinatorics, including a chapter devoted to spanning sets and the threshold functions phi, phi-pm, phi-hat, phi-hat-pm.
status_evidence.claim: The spanning-set thresholds are posed as open research problems across all finite abelian groups.
